english: A fast area attack that teleports you.
translation: Atac rapid pe zona care va teleporteaza.

english: Has a chance to poison the opponent.

english: Shoots several arrows in a row. Chance of a piercing shot.

english: A spinning attack with three chances to hit and a chance to poison the opponent.

english: A ranged area attack. Has a chance to set the target on fire.

english: A long-range attack on several targets. Has a chance to slow the opponent.

english: Area attack. Has a chance to stun the opponent.

english: A long-range attack that stuns the opponent.

english: Skill books without the day's wait
translation: Carti de abilitate fara asteptarea zilnica

english: The game makes a character wait about a day between two reads of the same skill, so a bot needs a month to read a skill from M1 to G1, and the books pile up in its bag meanwhile. On: a bot reads a book the moment it has one - the game itself is the only brake. Off: the game's daily wait, unchanged.
translation: Jocul face un personaj sa astepte aproximativ o zi intre doua citiri ale aceleiasi abilitati, asa ca un bot are nevoie de o luna ca sa duca o abilitate de la M1 la G1, iar cartile se aduna intre timp in rucsac. Pornit: botul citeste o carte imediat ce o are - singura frana este jocul insusi. Oprit: asteptarea zilnica a jocului, neschimbata.

english: The share of stall keepers that put their weak upgrades (+0 to +3) on the counter for pennies instead of selling them to an NPC - scrap for burning at the blacksmith, as on hard servers. Off by default.
translation: Proportia de negustori care isi pun imbunatatirile slabe (+0 pana la +3) pe taraba pentru cativa banuti in loc sa le vanda unui NPC - material de ars la fierar, ca pe serverele grele. Oprit implicit.

english: The share of bots that stay by the stalls for a while after an errand in town instead of going straight back to hunting. At 100 percent the town is lively, at 0 everyone is out in the field.
translation: Proportia de boti care raman o vreme langa tarabe dupa un drum in oras in loc sa se intoarca direct la vanatoare. La 100 la suta orasul e plin de viata, la 0 toata lumea e pe teren.

english: Moonlight Chest - from a killed monster
translation: Cufarul Luminii Lunii - de la un monstru ucis

english: How often a chest drops: from a killed monster and from a broken Metin. The game default is 1 and 30 percent; more chests mean more bonus scrolls, speed potions and Blessing Scrolls for the bots. Applies within five seconds, to bots and players alike.
translation: Cat de des cade un cufar: dintr-un monstru ucis si dintr-un Metin spart. Valoarea implicita a jocului este 1 si 30 la suta; mai multe cufere inseamna mai multe suluri de bonus, potiuni de viteza si suluri de binecuvantare pentru boti. Se aplica in cinci secunde, pentru boti si jucatori deopotriva.

english: Moonlight Chest - from a broken Metin

english: Reading books to push a skill from M towards G.

english: The stable and hunting medals in the Monkey Dungeon.

english: Hunting Metins instead of common monsters.

english: Fighting together, not every bot on its own.

english: Hunting for the level-up on the map the mission names.
